lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The session ends in shouting, then in an evacuation, then in nothing at all. The floor does not sit again that month.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Six months later the Handover is enacted by executive order: unamended, unread, unopposed, and eleven pages shorter because nobody required a summary. Vesely's post is abolished in the same instrument, on page four, under efficiencies.

lines.speaker: mara_vesely
lines.text: You stopped a vote. You did not stop a treaty. Those are not the same object and it took me four years and a postgraduate qualification to learn the difference, so I am not going to pretend I expected you to know it.
